name: @zipir/mcp

tools.name: list_formats
tools.description:
The video formats a lesson can use

The same catalog the panel and the upload endpoint accept; read it instead of hard-coding ids.

tools.name: create_lesson
tools.description:
Start a lesson (202)

Send a document as multipart, or `text`/`url` as JSON. The lesson id is usable immediately; `GET /v1/lessons/{id}` follows it. With an `Idempotency-Key`, the same request inside 24 hours returns the same lesson (the same key with a different body is 409).

text.description: The lesson text itself (UTF-8, max 5 MB).

url.description: A public http(s) page; its readable text becomes the document.

format.description: Video format. GET /v1/formats lists the live set.

file_path.description: Path to a local file on this machine (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, MD, TXT; max 50 MB).

tools.name: get_lesson
tools.description:
One lesson: status, phase, duration, error, next step

`status` is the machine state (queued | rendering | done | failed); `phase` is finer. `needs_approval` is true while the storyboard waits for its approval. `next` is what the client should do: `approve` (POST /v1/lessons/{id}/approve), `download`, `wait`, or null when nothing can be done.

tools.name: approve_lesson
tools.description:
Approve the storyboard and start the video (202)

The same approval as the panel's button: the minutes are held, the render is queued. The approved storyboard is the lesson's current one (`next: "approve"` in GET /v1/lessons/{id}). A second approval of a started lesson is 409 `already_started`; with an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry answers the job it already queued (202, same `job_id`).

tools.name: get_download
tools.description:
A signed, time-limited download link

The answer is a URL (900 s) to the finished MP4, not the file itself. `variant=720` is the light copy every plan gets; `variant=1080` is the full quality and needs a paid plan (402 `plan_required` on the free one).

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description:
This key's minutes for the account's current period

The limit is the account's existing entitlement (optionally narrowed per key at creation), never a second rule; `used` counts finished video minutes of lessons this key started.
